entries.title: Claude works again as soon as an early limit reset gives your allowance back
entries.body: After Claude stopped a turn on a spent limit, such as the Fable limit, and you then used a reset that gives that limit back early, Infinitary kept showing that limit at 0 and kept your Claude account paused until the original reset time. Now the next allowance reading that shows the allowance back clears the 0 and lets your first mate and crewmates use Claude again.
entries.noPicture: The meter clears only after a real Claude refusal followed by an early reset, which the app's test launcher cannot stage.
